tools.name: watch_job
tools.description: Start the lightning-jobs live-progress poller (`lightning job watch`, or `progress.py watch` where the CLI lacks it) for a Lightning job, or for a log file in a Studio, outside the agent sandbox. The progress bars then show above the prompt and you get a message for each event that needs a reply. Returns the run name the poller tracks.
